verdict.rationale: Portkey documents per-API-key budget and rate limits that automatically block usage once limits are hit, giving spend and usage scoping. It also offers model allow-lists at org and workspace level and keeps provider credentials stored centrally rather than in code. The evidence never shows per-key permission scopes or a least-privilege key model aimed at agents. missing for 10: explicit per-key permission/role scopes, per-key model or provider allow-lists (only org/workspace level is documented), agent-specific credential issuance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
